forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M3A6CJRDYEA2YJ9ANY4XPK60
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8a80
+title: 'Make two unit tests prove their claims: the reload burst and the waiting siblings'
+---
+## What
+1. `AgentRegistryReloadTests.burstOfWritesGivesOneFinalCatalog` takes the first published catalog and expects all writes in it. On a busy CI machine, writes that take longer than the watcher's quiet period give a partial first catalog, and the test fails. It also does not prove that only one final catalog comes. Change it: wait with `onReload.first { <the last write is in it> }`, then assert the full id list.
+2. `NestedRunTests+Limits.waitingSiblingsLetChildrenStart` uses no gates, so the children end at once. It passes even if a waiting run still holds a slot. Change it: hold both children with gates, and wait until both siblings are in the waiting phase before the second child starts. Then release the gates.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The burst test passes when the writes are split over two quiet periods (test it by a delay between two halves of the burst).
+- [ ] The sibling test fails if `isWorking` ignores `.waitingForChildren` (check by a temporary change during development), and passes with the real code.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] The two changed tests.
+- [ ] Run each test 5 times alone, then the full suite. Expected: pass each time.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
